title: A cascading cut
notes: One tree of 16 keys. Lowering 44 to 15 cuts it from 19, and 19 gets a mark. Lowering 41 to 14 cuts it from 17, and 17 gets a mark. Then lowering 31 to 9 cuts 31 from 19; 19 was marked, so it is cut too, and so is 17 above it. Three cuts from one decreaseKey, and every mark is gone.
